title: QA Tester-Gen AI
description:
Job Description 
 We are looking for a QA Tester GenAI Team to take ownership of quality assurance across AI-powered applications. The candidate will be responsible for functional, API, web application, performance, security, and GenAI testing while helping establish structured QA processes within the team. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design and execute test cases for functional, regression, integration, system and negative testing. Test web applications, APIs and backend workflows. Validate data flow, integrations, authentication, error handling and business rules. Test GenAI applications for response accuracy, relevance, consistency and hallucinations. Identify edge cases and test beyond happy-path scenarios. Perform load and performance testing. Perform basic application security testing covering authentication, authorization, input validation, session handling and data exposure. Identify, document and track defects with clear reproduction steps. Verify fixes and work closely with developers. Define QA standards, checklists and testing processes. Support testing across multiple projects and POCs. 
 Required Skills 
 3–5 years of experience in Software Testing / QA. Strong knowledge of Manual Testing and test case design. Hands-on experience in Web Application Testing . Hands-on experience in API Testing . Good knowledge of Postman . Experience with Jira . Basic SQL / Database Querying knowledge. Experience with JMeter or equivalent load-testing tools . Good understanding of SDLC / STLC. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Good defect reporting and documentation skills. Basic understanding of OWASP Top 10 / application security testing . 
 Good to Have 
 Selenium or Playwright OWASP ZAP or Burp Suite Git / GitHub Swagger / OpenAPI Usability testing GenAI / LLM application testing Chatbot or RAG testing Prompt testing Experience testing hallucinations and unsupported responses Knowledge of prompt injection and data leakage testing. Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who: Has a strong testing mindset. Can identify edge cases and risks. Can question requirements and think beyond predefined test cases. Can work independently and take ownership of QA activities. Can collaborate effectively with developers and provide constructive feedback. Has an analytical and logical approach to problem-solving.

Key Skills: Manual Testing,JIRA,JMeter,API Testing,Postman,Regression Testing,Software Testing,Database Testing
